title: Ozuna Extends Latin Airplay Chart Legacy With 38th No. 1, ‘Una Aventura’: ‘Thank You for Always Being by My Side’
summary: The singer strengthens his standing as the act with the second-most chart-toppers on the 32-year-old ranking.
contentText:
Ozuna notches his 38th No. 1 on Billboard ’s Latin Airplay chart as “Una Aventura” hits the top of the June 27-dated ranking. The singer tightens his hold as the artist with the second-most No. 1s in Latin Airplay history. Only J Balvin has more, with 40.

“I feel incredibly grateful to everyone who has connected with ‘Una Aventura,’” Ozuna tells Billboard . “It was the song that marked the beginning of this new musical chapter for me in 2026, and I felt from the start that it was special. But seeing how the audience has embraced it — and continues to make it their own — brings me so much joy.”

Related

Cuisillos Complete Comeback to No. 1 on Regional Mexican Airplay With ‘Aunque Me Duela’

Morat Turns Los Bukis’ ’80s Classic ‘Tu Cárcel’ Into a Billboard Latin Airplay No. 1

La Receta Gets First Billboard No. 1 With Joss Favela Collab ‘Que Belleza de Mujer’

“Una Aventura” lifts 2-1 on the overall Latin Airplay chart after a 7% growth in audience impressions, to 7 million, earned in the United States, during the June 12-18 tracking week, according to Luminate. The new champ lands just two months after Ozuna’s “Enemigos,” with Beéle and Ovy on the Drums, crowned for one week in April.

Ozuna adds to his strong run with 38 No. 1s, continuing to rank second for the most No. 1s in the nearly 32-year history of the tally. Among all acts, J Balvin still leads with 40 chart-toppers. Here’s how the leaderboard looks:

- J Balvin, 40

- Ozuna, 38

- Enrique Iglesias, 32

- Bad Bunny, 31

- Daddy Yankee, 30

- Maluma, 26

- Romeo Santos, 24

Latin Airplay has seen 23 No. 1 songs year to date, with nearly all spending only one week at No. 1. Notably, Ozuna joins an elite group of artists, unaccompanied by another act, who have achieved a solo No. 1 in 2026. Previously, Danny Ocean’s “Corazón,” Carlos Vives’ “Te Dedico” and Arcángel’s “Hoy Se Guaya” ruled for one week each between February-June.

In addition to its Latin Airplay coronation, where “Una Aventura” dethrones Morat’s “Tu Cárcel” after the latter drops 1-4 following a 23% decline in impressions (to 5.9 million), Ozuna remains No. 1 on the Latin Rhythm Airplay chart for a second consecutive week. Thanks to its radio gains, “Una Aventura” also climbs 17-14 on the overall Hot Latin Songs list, marking Ozuna’s best showing since “Monotonía,” with Shakira, reached No. 3 in 2022.

Ozuna’s new achievement lands on the heels of his Una Aventura World Tour, which launched in Ibiza, Spain, on June 16.

“The love this song has received has been so overwhelming that I decided my new concert tour would carry the same name: Una Aventura,” Ozuna adds. “To my fans, thank you for always being by my side and for continuing to be part of every adventure in my musical journey.”
